content.summary: This is a detailed specification of the Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP), RFC 1350. It defines the data transfer protocol and control messages.
key_features: Data packets contain opcode, block number, and data field
Block numbers start at 1 and increment by one for each new block
Last block is identified by data length of 0 to 511 bytes
DATA packets are acknowledged by ACK or ERROR packets
ACK packet echoes the block number being acknowledged

protocol_messages.RRQ: Read Request - sends filename and mode
protocol_messages.WRQ: Write Request - sends filename and mode

termination_handling: Transfer completes when DATA packet has 0-511 bytes
Server may terminate connection after final ACK
Timeout handling is essential for detecting transfer failures
